ItemID: unavailable; Title: Inkbird ITC-308 Digital Temperature Controller 2-Stage Outlet Thermostat Heating and Cooling Mode Carboy Homebrew Fermenter Greenhouse Terrarium 110V 10A 1100W; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no current temperature-control project that would call for this.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Strenco 2 Inch Hook and Loop Strips with Adhesive - 5 Yards - Heavy Duty Tape - Black Sticky Back Fastener; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Removable fastening would complement the duct tape and adhesives I have used for practical repairs.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: 340PCS Solder Seal Wire Connectors-haisstronica Marine Grade Heat Shrink Wire Connectors-Butt Splice Wire Terminals for Marine,Electrical with Corrosion and Weatherproof(5Colors/5Sizes); ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Sealed wire joints fit my repair interests, but I would choose just one connector kit this time.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Gorilla Super Glue Gel, 20 Gram, Clear, (Pack of 10); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Adhesives are useful to me, but ten tubes are more than I currently need.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: 5/16"-18 Stainless Hex Nut (100 Pack), by Bolt Dropper, 304 18-8 Stainless Steel Nuts; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I would need a repair requiring this exact thread size before buying a hundred nuts.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: MILAPEAK 270 PCS Heat Shrink Tubing Kit - 3:1 Ratio Adhesive Lined, Marine Grade Shrink Wrap - Automotive Industrial Heat-Shrink Tubing - Black, Red; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Assorted tubing would help insulate connections made with my existing spade terminals.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: TICONN 100pcs Heat Shrink Butt Connectors Kit, Insulated Waterproof Electrical Marine Automotive Wire Crimp Terminals, Butt Splice (3 Colors / 3 Sizes) (100PCS); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: A crimp connector assortment fits my previous electrical supplies and adds sealed inline connections.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: XHF 1-1/4 Inch (30mm) 3:1 Waterproof Heat Shrink Tubing Marine Grade Wire Cable Adhesive Lined Tube Insulation Seal Against Moisture Corrosion and Air Leakage, 4 Ft Red; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no specific use for tubing this large; an assortment suits my general repairs better.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Kuject 120PCS Solder Seal Wire Connectors, Self-Solder Heat Shrink Butt Connector Solder Sleeve Waterproof Insulated Electrical Butt Splice Wire Terminals for Marine Automotive Boat Truck Wire Joint; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: These could suit electrical repairs, but I would try the crimp connector kit first rather than buy overlapping supplies.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Premium Grade Cyanoacrylate (CA) Super Glue by STARBOND - 16 OZ Complete Refill KIT (453-gram) - Super Fast Thin 2 CPS Viscosity Adhesive for Woodturning, CA Finish, Woodworking, Hobby Models, Inlay; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: This large refill and thin adhesive seem aimed at work I have not needed supplies for.
